entries.9fec0fef8b1108a4: The company is Japan's only securities finance company, supporting the infrastructure functions of the securities and financial markets. Under the provisions of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, it holds a license from the Prime Minister for margin transactions, and by lending funds and shares required for systemized margin trading to securities companies, it contributes to the smooth circulation of shares and proper price formation.
